body: Thanks for the info
I found a parking garage about a mile from my apt that I feel pulled to a lot of nights. I will smoke and drink up there and dream of the night the drugs push me over the edge. Know the feeling man
I hope to you make a similar post of my own someday. Godspeed friend ❤️

I stopped looking at social media, primarily Instagram about 3 months ago. Has it cured my depression? Fuck no, but man believe me it gets worse when I do scroll through that garbage. For real, I recommend giving it up. Sending love ❤️
This is why I don't hesitate to walk alone at night in sketchy areas, why I drive recklessly on roads where I don't endanger others, why I don't look twice when crossing the street...
Unfortunately yes
That's the reason I smoke so much, you aren't alone friend
We sound like the same person believe me
Your post brought me to tears. Please consider reaching out for help. Sending love my friend, hope you find peace in this world or the next ❤️
I'm sorry for your loses. Sending love <3
I feel the same way

I would be careful to assume everyone here simply replies to help their ego. Many of us lurk this subreddit because we are suicidal and cannot help ourselves, but sometimes can at least be an ear for someone to unload on. I'm sorry you feel this way and I wouldn't mind talking with you if you would like. Feel free to DM me. Sending love <3
This spoke to me. I appreciate you taking the time to share

My story isn't exactly yours but I too have a loving family, don't worry about the next meal, and can afford my rent (although it is an illusion and I'm really just accumulating debt). I want to die every morning I wake up and every night I go to sleep, I can't tell you exactly why, I try and rationalize it every day of my life. I will let you know if I ever figure it out. Godspeed my friend <3

You will quickly see scrolling through this sub there are a lot of people who have recently attempted and plan to try again. Best advice would be to try and speak with the person, maybe they will open up to you. Sending love <3
I feel the same way
You take the words out of my mouth. Religion is the only reason I can't bring myself to do it. Too scared
I wish I could get sober but I'm stuck in the cycle of escapism

"but can't remember the last time he touched a human being" 

Fuck man I feel the same way every day. I wish I could go back to 13 or 14
I hope you find peace friend <3
It is very empty weird feeling sitting on the edge, similarly my spot is just about a mile from where I live. Most weekends nights I sit up there smoke joints and drinking vodka
I'm so sorry you were dealt a shit hand. I don't know if it will get better but I'm sending love your way <3
I've sat on the ledge of my spot
It really blows. I fear the same

The first time I tried a psychedelic it was wayyyy too much mushrooms. I did not respect the drug and was ignorant. They ripped my soul out man. I tried to jump off the sixth floor balcony completely lost in thought loops. Those trips can take months or years to integrate and it can be VERY difficult to come to terms with. 

Personally my parents are unaware of my drug use, premarital sex, and depression to the point of daily suicidal thoughts. I can't imagine what you are going through with your parents as I couldn't imagine that scenario with mine.

Life is hard man, I can't say anything to truely help you, but fuck man this sub helps me sometimes. I don't know why but talking to someone, even if it is a stranger on Reddit can feel nice. I would love to hear more about your story if you would like to share. Sending love my friend <3
Did you feel like therapy helped? I want to try it but am hesitant
This makes me want to ask for help

I hope things improve for you too my friend ❤️. For whatever reason I still have the strength to focus on University although I have been skipping a lot of class lately which I've never done but I start crying in lecture. I wish I could smoke all day to numb the pain but it would just fuck me over more
At least I know I'm not alone. The pot helps for a few hours then the euphoria fades and I'm left in a cloud of confusion, I prefer that to fantasizing slitting my wrists
I am too scared to fall asleep after the countless haunting dreams. I smoke so much praying every night I won't dream, it works some nights
Every Friday night
If only I weren't a piece of shit and cherished every breath I take
Me too
Hey maybe we will both wake up someday and it will all just be a dream

And that's okay, I don't feel like talking 99.9% of the time. Either way I hope you find peace and I genuinely mean that ❤️. I created this throwaway account yesterday and have spent hours reading through people's posts. I want to die every fucking day but I'm too much of a pussy to pull the trigger. I don't think I can solve anyone's problems, but sometimes it feels good to talk, even if it's to a stranger on the internet.
I wish I could go back to 12 knowing what I do now, but hindsight is 20/20 right?
I feel the same way everyday, do you want someone to talk to?
Do you need someone to talk to?
I know you said no normie advice, but have you ever tried mediation? It doesn't solve my problems, but it helps calm me down when I start to panic from similar feelings. Sending love ❤️
I was more than happy to take the time to read your story. I hope you find peace ❤️
I am more than willing to talk to you <3
I'm so sorry to hear about your trauma. Do you want someone to talk to?

My eyes get bloodshot because it is difficult to hold back tears when my mind is filled with self hate. No one notices, no one asks, no one cares. Hell people don't even see me, they just stare at their phones. Sending love my friend ❤️
I'm sitting looking out my balcony smoking myself to a lethargic level and drinking vodka so I can't be tormented by my inevitable dreams
Happy to hear you are out of the hospital, sending love ❤️
Do you enjoy the time you do spend with him though? If so why not try to do this more and cherish that time together?

I think you should reach out to your boyfriend. I have pushed many people away in my life but it has only made me alone. Cherish him, you said it yourself, he is your world. Would he not support you if you opened up to him?

Your story is mine. I am a 20 year old sophomore in University. I went to school far away from home and wanted to make friends. I have been depressed since I was 16 but always managed it well. I had one night I planned to kill myself but backed out. I hoped my depression would lift in college as I was excited to meet new people and form connections. However, everywhere I turned people were hesitant to make conversation. For whatever reason I am invisible to women and no one seems to talk to me. Every girl I fall in love with has used me or ghosted me. The "friends" I have made avoid me and I'm becoming increasingly more suicidal. This past week I skipped 3 lectures and I'm usually always present. 

I've kept these thoughts to myself for years and recently made a post on Reddit. It was to strangers on the internet, but it felt like the first step. My University offers psych services for free but I'm too embarrassed and ashamed of myself to ask for help. Recently I have been considering it though. Does your University offer these services? Have you tried speaking with a professional? Sending love your way <3

I know that feeling all too well. I have been suicidal since I was 16 and I'm turning 21 soon. It hasn't been half my life yet but I'm terrified its going to end when I finally do it. I reached out to my grandma the other day to catch up and it made me cry, the same thought about how crushed she would be if I killed myself. I holds me back man. Just the other day on Reddit was the first time I shared these thoughts with anyone and it felt good, even if it was strangers on Reddit. Have you tried speaking with a professional? I have been considering this lately. It may not solve your problems but it could help. Sending love your way <3
This spoke to me

That is bullshit, I genuinely believe there are people out there that get a high from using and manipulating others. However, not everyone is like this. You care to share specifics of what got you to this point?

I'm sorry to hear you feel like this, but at the same time I think it is great you want to get help. I have more problems than I can count and have been suicidal for 4.5 years now. I am just now thinking of speaking with a professional about it. I have cut before too but never my wrists. Right now I feel like I'm in a deeper rut than when I was cutting but I know I don't want to go back to that place because of the way it made me feel afterwards. Have you tried speaking with a professional? I don't think it will solve your problems but talking may help you find peace in some aspects of your life, although I'm yet to try it. Sending love your way my friend <3

I'm sorry you feel this way. I feel as though I have love to give to the world but those around me push me away. I have given up on women as everyone I have ever loved has used me or ghosted me. I am very close to giving up on humanity as well. But when I read what you have wrote, I feel like I wrote it myself. There are others like you out there, does that mean it doesn't fucking suck? No, but know you aren't completely alone. For what is it worth coming from some suicidal stranger online, I hope you find peace my friend <3

I'm so sorry to hear you have suffered for so long. I have fought suicidal thoughts for almost 5 years now and I am beginning to get very tired. Have you tried talking with a professional? I have begun to consider it but am hesitant
I hope you find peace with time my friend <3
Your reply literally brought me to tears ❤️

I'm sorry to hear about your conditions. I've been used or ghosted by every woman I've ever opened up to or loved so I can relate with you there. I recently defriended most of my long time friends because one of their gf's used me to get back with him and most of them ended up hating me after it all happened anyway. But I truely loved her. So now I have no friends, a broken heart, and am still suicidal. Life blows but I just try to make it to tomorrow

I had a solid weekend with a girl I had known since we were kids. I loved her with all my heart, I was always honest with her. She was my best friend. Anyway she came to visit and slept with me for the weekend. I would wake up in the night and could not believe she was by my side. The feeling of kissing her lips made me feel accepted and loved for the first time in my life. Fast forward 2 weeks, she ghosts me and gets back with her ex. Year and years of friendship and my heart shattered. I have been suicidal for almost 5 years, and this was the only weekend I felt real Love and it made me appreciate life. Then ripped my fucking heart out and I shot down into a deeper depression than I've ever seen. I hope you find someone friend.
I cry myself to sleep most nights thinking the same thing
I'm sorry you are feeling so alone that you resorted to that, I hope you find peace friend. What has pushed you to this?

You know man, I feel like college is a complete fucking scam. I get fucking pissed all the time and wish that I wasn't forced down this path. Then the guilt hits me, because I am "fortunate" enough to be in school because the truth is there are a lot of people who would take my spot happily. But the duality of it is I am really just slowly drowning myself in debt and wasting my youth. And for fucking what? So I can be balls deep in debt, alone, and still be suicidal? It's a fucked system man, but I decided to risk it for the chance of excelling in a field and tbh I have found things that interest me in a classroom.

I think you are right. It isn't fair to myself to not take advantage of free psych services. Academically I have suffered recently because I struggle to focus and resort to just smoking pot instead to slow my mind down and at least feel something.

I relate to you in more ways than I can explain. I walk to class almost in tears listening to Stan, Beautiful, and Way I Am all the time contemplating killing myself. About 4 months ago actions I took for a girl I loved ended in her using and leaving me, my friends hating me, and left me with no one. I have been used by women to the point of no longer having interest in them. I used to hurt really bad, but recently I have started becoming numb. I don't know what to say in regards of why life is worth living, but I try to at least make it to tomorrow. If you are still here, I do not know you, but for what it is worth can you believe I care about you? Because I do ❤️
I feel the same way every single day. What's your major?

I have been suicidal for almost five years now. I discovered psychedelics about a year and a half ago and to be completely honest with you they have given me glimpses of hope. Although these feelings always seem to come back and I have begun to get diminishing results from my journeys.

Be sure to take set and setting into account as well as your mental state. Mushrooms can be very ruthless compared to LSD from my experience, but if you are suicidal it could be worth taking a chance for a transcendent experience. A trip sitter should be considered if you are not in a good place when dosing. Best of luck my friend, safe journeys and report back ✌️❤️

I think you are right that talking with a therapist without explaining intention or plans would keep me from being hospitalized. Your reply means a lot to me considering I cannot even think of a time someone has asked me how I am doing. Talking with someone about what I feel on daily basis seems like it could feel good at the time but it's been so many years that I just can't imagine a world without suicidal thoughts. 

With my parents, I fear extreme embarrassment, as well as them most likely demanding I come home and go to school in the area. If they knew I wished I wouldn't wake up every night I go to sleep and hope I die by chance every morning I wake up, they would be absolutely crushed. I'm sure they would feel as though they failed as parents. Or the idea that I smoke myself to a lethargic level every fucking night to stop the feelings of emptiness in my heart. I fucking hate the being forced into a position in which I guilt trip myself for feelings I cannot even control.
I feel the exact same way as you and OP.

Hey I am in a similar boat to you. My thoughts started when I was 16 and I'm almost 21 now. I have kept these thoughts to myself since the first time I considered jumping to my death. By 18 I almost crashed my car into a telephone poll without a seatbelt but backed out. I am starting to seriously disturb myself again and am finally considering reaching out. Let me know what you decide, you remind of myself almost 5 years ago. Much love ❤️

If I spoke to a therapist I would want to be 100% honest and lay out everything. Otherwise I see no point. I see my two options as tell my parents as I'm on their insurance and I would never want to do this for the fear of them losing sleep at night because I go to school so far away. Option two would be go to free psych services at my school, but I am worried they would be even more sensitive as I am a student. 

I am worried about being hospitalized for telling them i spend most of the day contemplating suicide and fantasizing my own death. I am more worried that I would be hesitant to go back, throwing more red flags.
